notes: Yuri authorised the repository-local authored-synthetic non-executing Synaptic Event Router protocol tranche on 2026-07-22.

Scope leases, route decisions, mailbox notices, fresh-read grants, supersession and compiled manifests are inert protocol data. The tool cannot connect to PostgreSQL, the event feed, product APIs, models, containers, live mailboxes or commands.

claim_scope: Repository-local authored-synthetic protocol validation, deterministic route projection, trace rendering and dry-run manifest compilation only.
The proof extends the accepted Sandbox DAG typed-exchange grammar while preserving immutable policy, forward-only attempts and terminal human authority.

decisions.summary: Prove deterministic event-to-scope steering, mailbox boundaries, fresh-read grants, supersession and dry-run policy manifests without attaching a runtime.
Accept the non-executing protocol proof with exact bilateral exchange policy, default-deny routing and no database, feed, product, model, container or command connection.

title: Ariadne Synaptic Event Router protocol
unresolved_gates: PostgreSQL, event-feed adapters, product APIs, operational persistence, live mailbox delivery, models, containers and commands require a fresh Yuri decision.
Additional event families, PII, Stage 3B, production, deployment, release and autonomous action remain separately closed.
